cookies.title: Cookie Policy

intro.title: What is a cookie?
intro.text: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. It allows the site to recognize your browser on subsequent visits.

items.name: Necessary (strictly necessary)
items.description: Essential for site functionality (language, theme, consent).

items.name: Analytics (Cloudflare Web Analytics)
items.description: Anonymous audience measurement to improve the site.
items.note: These cookies are managed by Cloudflare. IP is anonymized. No personal data is collected.

consent.title: Consent management
consent.text: On your first visit, a banner asks you to accept or refuse analytics cookies. Your choice is stored for 13 months via the cookie_consent cookie.

withdraw.title: Withdrawing consent
withdraw.text: You can change your mind at any time by clicking "Manage cookies" in the footer, or by deleting the cookie_consent cookie from your browser.

refuseConsequence.title: Consequences of refusal
refuseConsequence.text: If you refuse analytics cookies: you will be redirected to our mirror renaheberg.pages.dev (same content, no Cloudflare analytics). You can accept cookies there to return to the main site.

gdpr.title: GDPR Rights — Exercising Your Rights

intro.title: Your rights over your personal data
intro.text: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — EU Regulation 2016/679) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights over your personal data.

items.name: Right of access
items.description: Obtain confirmation that your data is being processed, and access to that data (copy, purposes, categories, recipients, retention period, origin).

items.name: Right to rectification
items.description: Have inaccurate or incomplete data concerning you corrected.

items.name: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
items.description: Request deletion of your data when no longer necessary, consent withdrawn, or processing is unlawful.

items.name: Right to restriction
items.description: Freeze the use of your data (e.g., during verification of rectification or objection).

items.name: Right to portability
items.description: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format, to transmit to another controller.

items.name: Right to object
items.description: Object at any time to processing on grounds relating to your particular situation (unless compelling legitimate grounds override).

items.name: Automated individual decisions
items.description: Not be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing producing legal effects concerning you.

exercise.title: How to exercise your rights?
steps: Identify the right(s) you wish to exercise
Or use the CNIL form: cnil.fr/exercising-your-rights
Attach ID if required (to verify your identity)
Specify the right(s) concerned and the processing (Cloudflare analytics)
exercise.timeline: The controller must respond within 1 month (extendable by 2 months for complexity). If refused, written reasons required.

verification.title: Identity verification
verification.text: To protect your data, ID proof may be requested (ID copy). It will be destroyed after verification.

refusal.title: In case of refusal or no response
refusal.text: You can lodge a complaint with the CNIL: cnil.fr/complaint or seek judicial remedy.

representative.title: Representative
representative.text: You may mandate a consumer association or lawyer to exercise your rights on your behalf.
